column1: # Start values for the clearCore GitHub Project board.
# scripts/github/create-project-board.sh reads this file. It sets a value only
# when the field on the board is empty, so a change on the board stays.
# These values are suggestions from the PR #275 triage. Change them here or on
# Columns (separate them with one TAB; write - for "no value"):
#   priority: P0 (do now) | P1 | P2 | P3 (low)
#   area:     Core | Pipeline | Assembler | TUI | Qt GUI | GDB stub | RISC-V | Branch prediction | CI / Build
#   size:     XS | S | M | L | XL
# An open issue that is not in this file gets Status Todo and a priority from
# its labels (bug or security: P1; feature or enhancement: P2; other: P3).
# Fixed by PR #275. The issues close when it merges.
